subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should native sub-agent completion announces gain a public `announceTarget` tool/config contract, or should OpenClaw keep depth-based delivery and solve only narrower routing bugs?
rationale: The implementation path is bounded, but the requested fix adds model-facing and config-facing semantics in a compatibility-sensitive agent orchestration surface.

options.title: Approve backward-compatible announceTarget
options.body: Add `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` to native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default to `channel`, and test parent injection plus current default delivery.

options.title: Keep current routing contract
options.body: Leave native completion delivery depth-based and direct users to `sessions_send` callbacks or narrower fixes for broken channel/thread routing.

options.title: Split into narrower follow-ups
options.body: Keep this issue as product direction but implement only related bugs such as thread inheritance, suppression, or A2A target repair in separate issues.

recommendation.title: Approve backward-compatible announceTarget
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` to native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default to `channel`, and test parent injection plus current default delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the spawn tool and unified the announce delivery pipeline where the durable contract would live.
